Text: Your game is good, but other games are more famous. Votes follow fame, so let us change that!
Hover over a voter (move the mouse there). A card shows what you can do.
Click a voter to Plug it. A Plug costs 1 Post and moves the voter towards your game.
The circle is conviction: how sure the voter is. Plug until the circle is empty. Then the voter joins you.
You are out of Posts. They come back slowly. Plug voters with many followers first.
You can also click your own voters. This makes them stronger, so they stay with you.
A padlock is a gate. The voter ignores you until enough of its followers back you. This is true for the other games too.
The gate opened because its followers joined you. This is the honest way.
Hold SHIFT for night shift. Sockpuppets (fake votes) ignore gates. Sticky Keys in the way? Press N.
Each sockpuppet adds {sockheat} Heat. Holding SHIFT adds {heatrate} a second. Heat goes down only when you let go of SHIFT.
The Mod Eye checks you every 12 to 35 seconds (see the countdown at the top). If Heat is above the red mark, you get a strike.
Strike! Your sockpuppets are removed and you are blocked for {ban} seconds. {strikes} strikes and you are out. Strikes never go away.
One more strike and you are out. Once per game, Shift the Blame (press B) if you have under {blamefake}% fake votes.
Space pauses. M mutes. Esc opens the menu. H shows how to play. The rest is up to you!
A voter changed sides. A shaking voter is about to leave. A coloured ring closing in on a voter is an attack.
Fake votes keep your Heat high while you hold them. A strike removes them all. Plug one until it is {launder} full to make it real.
Final check: all fake votes are removed. Sockpuppet votes from the last {review} seconds are removed too, even if you made them real.
Right-click your own voter to Rally: {rallycost} Post protects it and its neighbours for {rallylock}s. Ready again in {rallycd}s.
A coloured ring closing in on your voter is an attack. Click the voter to parry it, or Rally it and its neighbours.
The Mod Eye looks away for {eyeaway} s! Fake votes add no Heat while it happens. The ones you already hold still warm you a little.
Sockpuppet votes are fake. They add Heat while you hold them. Keep them under {fakelimit}% or a strike removes them all.
The rival attacks a lot in the last days, then it runs out of Posts. Your Posts come back {pushpct}% faster, so use them!
You are in first place! The other games attack the leader, so expect rings in every colour.
The other games fight too. They attack the leader and can take a big voter from it. A note says who took what.
You lead by more than {sympathy} points, so voters start to support the other games. Your lead shrinks. Keep reinforcing.
If you take a voter from a game, it hits back for {grudge} seconds. Click the voter when its ring closes in, or you lose it.
